title: Ridgeline Tool Rental Damage Deductible Billing Reference
content:
Under Ridgeline Tool Rental damage protection, the renter's deductible for a damage incident is billed as a deductible fee line on the agreement. This is the agent reference for booking that line.

## Capability

`bill_damage_deductible_c7701c46` books a single damage protection deductible fee line, dated today, for a damage incident on one returned Ridgeline Tool Rental agreement, and raises the amount the renter owes on the agreement by exactly the amount billed. The renter sees the deductible as its own fee line and a higher balance. The tool records the amount it is given and does not work it out.

## How it is invoked

The tool is agent-side. The Customer Care agent unlocks `bill_damage_deductible_c7701c46` and then calls it.

## Parameters

- `rental_agreement_id` — the reference number of the rental agreement (one equipment item) the deductible is billed on, as returned by the rental agreement lookup. Id.
- `deductible_amount` — the deductible in USD, as a positive number with 2 decimal places and no currency sign; the value is stored by standard rounding to 2 decimal places.

## Return

| Field | Content |
|---|---|
| `status` | "billed" when the deductible line was booked |
| `rental_charge_id` | reference of the new fee line |
| `rental_agreement_id` | the agreement it was booked on |
| `fee_type` | always `damage_deductible` |
| `amount` | the deductible billed, USD with 2 decimal places |
| `balance_due` | the amount now owed on the agreement, USD with 2 decimal places |

## Illustration (hypothetical values)

`deductible_amount` 375.20 on an agreement owing 120.00 returns `status` "billed", `fee_type` `damage_deductible`, `amount` 375.20 and `balance_due` 495.20.
